useful_god.rationale: Day Master Water is strong; Wood balances the chart.

yogas.name: Gaja-Kesari
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in the 1st sign from the Moon.

yogas.name: Budha-Aditya
yogas.reason: Sun is in Sagittarius and Mercury in Scorpio; Budha-Aditya needs both in the same sign.

yogas.name: Chandra-Mangala
yogas.reason: Moon is in Scorpio and Mars in Sagittarius; Chandra-Mangala needs both in the same sign.

yogas.name: Ruchaka
yogas.reason: Mars is in Sagittarius, neither its own sign (Aries, Scorpio) nor its exaltation sign (Capricorn).

yogas.name: Bhadra
yogas.reason: Mercury is in Scorpio, neither its own sign (Gemini, Virgo) nor its exaltation sign (Virgo).

yogas.name: Hamsa
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in Scorpio, neither its own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces) nor its exaltation sign (Cancer).

yogas.name: Malavya
yogas.reason: Venus is in Capricorn, neither its own sign (Taurus, Libra) nor its exaltation sign (Pisces).

yogas.name: Sasa
yogas.reason: Saturn is in Sagittarius, neither its own sign (Capricorn, Aquarius) nor its exaltation sign (Libra).

yogas.name: Harsha
yogas.reason: The 6th house is Aries; its lord Mars is in the 2nd house; Harsha needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Sarala
yogas.reason: The 8th house is Gemini; its lord Mercury is in the 1st house; Sarala needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Vimala
yogas.reason: The 12th house is Libra; its lord Venus is in the 3rd house; Vimala needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Neecha Bhanga
yogas.reason: Moon is debilitated in Scorpio and no cancellation condition holds: (a) Mars, lord of Scorpio, is 2nd from the Lagna and 2nd from the Moon; (b) Venus, lord of Taurus (Moon's exaltation sign), is 3rd from the Lagna and 3rd from the Moon; (c) no classical planet is exalted in Scorpio. A kendra is the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th.

yogas.name: Sunapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Sagittarius): Mars and Saturn; 12th from the Moon (Libra): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Anapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Sagittarius): Mars and Saturn; 12th from the Moon (Libra): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Durudhara
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Sagittarius): Mars and Saturn; 12th from the Moon (Libra): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Kemadruma
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Sagittarius): Mars and Saturn; 12th from the Moon (Libra): none (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count); Kemadruma means both are empty.

yogas.name: Vesi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Capricorn): Venus; 12th from the Sun (Scorpio): Mercury and Jupiter (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Vasi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Capricorn): Venus; 12th from the Sun (Scorpio): Mercury and Jupiter (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Ubhayachari
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Capricorn): Venus; 12th from the Sun (Scorpio): Mercury and Jupiter (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Subha Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 2nd house: none; in the 12th: none. Subha Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Papa Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural malefics (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu) in the 2nd house: Sun, Mars and Saturn; in the 12th: none. Papa Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Parivartana
yogas.reason: Mars is in Sagittarius (ruled by Jupiter) and Jupiter is in Scorpio (ruled by Mars).

yogas.name: Mangal Dosha
yogas.reason: Mars is 2nd from the Lagna, 2nd from the Moon and 12th from Venus; the dosha houses are the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th and 12th.

yogas.name: Kala Sarpa
yogas.reason: Planets lie on both sides of the Rahu–Ketu axis: Sun, Moon, Mars, Venus and Saturn on one, Mercury and Jupiter on the other.

yogas.name: Amala
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 10th from the Lagna (Leo): none; in the 10th from the Moon (Leo): none.

yogas.name: Dhana
yogas.reason: The 2nd lord Jupiter and the 9th lord Moon are linked: Jupiter and Moon are both in Scorpio.

yogas.name: Dhana
yogas.reason: The 2nd lord Jupiter and the 11th lord Mercury are linked: Jupiter and Mercury are both in Scorpio.

yogas.name: Dhana
yogas.reason: The 9th lord Moon and the 11th lord Mercury are linked: Moon and Mercury are both in Scorpio.

yogas.name: Dharma-Karmadhipati
yogas.reason: The 9th lord Moon (Scorpio) and the 10th lord Sun (Sagittarius) share no sign, mutual aspect or sign exchange.

yogas.name: Nakshatra Parivartana
yogas.reason: No two bodies occupy each other's nakshatras; nakshatra lords: Sun Venus, Moon Mercury, Mars Venus, Mercury Mercury, Jupiter Saturn, Venus Moon, Saturn Ketu, Rahu Mercury, Ketu Mars.
